results.fact: Where the rocky gully starts and where the 'small basin' sits
results.correct_value: The rocky gully is climbed TO a small basin at ~4,300 ft; from there straight up and left up a second gully to the basin east of the summit at ~5,400 ft.
results.evidence: A detailed trip report of the Jefferson Creek route says the rocky gully 'is climbed until it reaches a small basin at ca.4300'', then the party went straight up and cut left up a gully into the basin east of the summit (ca.5400'). Within the row, approach, waypoints[2] (elev 4300 pin named for the basin), waypoints[3] (5,400 ft upper basin), approach_variants[0].baseFinding and climbing_route[0] all agree; only beta and pitch_detail[0] shift the basin to 5,400 ft. A second independent source with elevations was not reachable (SummitPost and Mountaineers returned 403), hence internal-plus-one.

results.fact: Parking fee / Northwest Forest Pass at Jefferson Creek
results.correct_value: No fee or pass is required to park at the Jefferson Creek crossing / Jefferson Lake trailhead area.
results.evidence: The Olympic National Forest recreation-site page for Jefferson Lake Trailhead states 'No fees are required for this site' and lists no restroom or water. The general Washington pass rule is that a Northwest Forest Pass is needed at national forest trailheads WITH facilities, which this undeveloped roadside turnout lacks. In the row, access.fees, access.notes, access.parking_pass and access.passRequired (four fields) all say no pass; only the trailhead waypoint's note and directions call it a Forest Pass area. overnight_permit.where speaks of other trailheads (Lena Lake, Brothers, Lake Cushman) and is left as is.

results.correct_value: June through September (best late July–September); drop the stray 'May–August' clause.
results.evidence: season (Jun-Sep), climate.bySeason.summer (late June through September), seasonal_guidance (Aug and Sep optimal, June risky) and approach_variants season (mid-July to September) agree; only the last sentence of best_season says May–August, and it is written as an attribution. Logged ascents on a peak-log site fall in June, August and October (none in May), and a late-June ascent report found the gullies still snow-filled, consistent with a June–September window rather than one opening in May and closing in August.

results.fact: Which trailhead area the crowds note describes
results.correct_value: The approach is from the Hamma Hamma / Jefferson Creek side, not Lake Cushman / Mount Rose; the crowds note should not frame visitors as Mount Rose hikers.
results.evidence: The Forest Service directions and a detailed route report both reach Pershing via Hamma Hamma River Road (FR 25), FR 2480 and FR 2401 to the Jefferson Creek crossing; the encyclopedia entry places the peak between the Hamma Hamma River and Jefferson Creek. Mount Rose is climbed from Lake Cushman in a different drainage. The replacement reuses the row's own estimatePerSeason comparison with Ellinor and Washington.
